split_rule: SHA256(domain || canonical raw vector digest); first 60 percent eligible for fit, next 20 development, last 20 reserved confirmation; choose lowest fit hashes up to exactly 500000 unique vectors
collision_policy: Require raw vectors unique; after fit-only scaling, drop development collisions with fit and confirmation collisions with fit or development before any scoring
preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on the 500000 fit rows only; float64 transform then float32; no clipping
loss: sqrt_weighted_ce with one fixed fit-training-mean denominator
selection: Highest final-development macro-F1 within each arm; ties choose lower learning rate. No best-epoch selection, new learning rates or architecture search.
screen_scope: Apply to selected shared_adam and MIME against selected standard central Adam and FedAvg. Passing warrants paired-seed confirmation, not a final success claim. Rare-class gain not required; zeros remain reported.
budget_interpretation: Exact backward-example budget, not equal FLOPs or wall time. Full MIME charges all full-anchor and paired local gradients. Full-participation population weights recomputed on fit subset. Communication modeled separately; no communication-matched efficacy claim.
sampling: Uniform with replacement within each client or pooled fit set. Same initialization and per-client round/step samples across federated arms and learning rates. One historical client partition, one exploratory training seed.
evaluation: Only final development endpoints. Confirmation features not materialized for scoring. Original validation and test arrays remain unopened.
limitations: Historical training rows are previously used research data; this is within-collection exploratory evidence, not independent session generalization. No privacy guarantee or physical network measurement.
